headline: TBR @ LAA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TBR 4.31 at LAA 4.42, with a projected total of 8.73. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAA: TBR moved -0.04 runs while LAA moved +0.69, changing the projected margin by -0.73 runs. The projected total climbed +0.66, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -6.5%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Casey Legumina has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Yandy Díaz, Wade Meckler, Junior Caminero, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Chandler Simpson, Hunter Feduccia because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
